summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Travel Animator NEW improvements. All 6 requested enhancements successfully implemented and working: 1) Title box with white frosted glass background (rgba(255,255,255,0.85)) and proper padding (24px 32px) 2) Icons animate inward with gatherIn animation from 100px outside orbit 3) Plane follows smooth Quadratic Bezier curve with control point at y=-20 4) Plane animation starts after 0.8s delay (icons gather first) 5) Plane uses lerp + requestAnimationFrame for 60fps smoothness 6) Plane rotation follows bezier tangent for natural direction. Mobile responsiveness (390x844) excellent. Route functionality still works perfectly after landing changes.
